subject.title: feat(fleet): multi-tenant hosting via openclaw fleet cell supervisor

question: After the schema and proof blockers are resolved, should OpenClaw core own `openclaw fleet` as the supported experimental baseline for isolating mutually untrusted tenants on one host?
rationale: This PR creates a security and support contract, not merely a CLI implementation; maintainers must accept the documented trust boundary, supported runtimes, and upgrade/purge obligations.

options.title: Sponsor experimental Fleet
options.body: Accept the core direction only after exact-head Linux/Podman and failure-restoration proof plus an explicit security review of the stated boundary.

options.title: Keep the supervisor external
options.body: Retain core guidance to run one Gateway per tenant but move lifecycle supervision to an external operator tool until the support and isolation contract matures.

recommendation.title: Sponsor experimental Fleet
recommendation.body: Accept the core direction only after exact-head Linux/Podman and failure-restoration proof plus an explicit security review of the stated boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored both the canonical design issue and the implementation, so is the clearest available owner for framing the final product/security choice.
